HomePage.heroSubtitle: Leading electrical contracting services in Kurdistan / Sulaymaniah, specializing in lighting repair & maintenance, new construction and renovations, and large-scale commercial projects.
HomePage.aboutText: Electrical Load is a leading provider of electrical contracting services servicing Kurdistan / Sulaymaniah. We specialize in lighting repair & maintenance, new construction and renovations, and large-scale commercial projects.
HomePage.servicesSubtitle: From electrical installation to solar systems, we deliver complete, guaranteed solutions.
HomePage.service1Desc: Complete electrical solutions including wiring, panels, grounding, protection systems, and low-voltage installations for residential, commercial, and industrial projects. Ensuring safety, reliability, and compliance with all standards.
HomePage.service2Desc: Design and installation of energy-efficient architectural, interior, and exterior lighting solutions, including landscape illumination, smart lighting controls, and customized lighting plans to enhance ambiance and functionality.
HomePage.service3Desc: Comprehensive network solutions including structured cabling, fiber optic installations, server room setup, network security, and enterprise network management to ensure seamless connectivity and optimal performance.
HomePage.service4Desc: Preparation of detailed electrical shop drawings, schematics, and layouts to guide accurate installation. Ensures compliance with standards, enhances coordination with contractors, and prevents project delays.
HomePage.service5Desc: Custom electrical design solutions including system planning, load calculations, layout design, and preparation of technical documentation. Tailored to meet the specific requirements of each project for efficient implementation.
HomePage.service6Desc: Turnkey solar energy solutions including system design, panel installation, energy production optimization, inverter setup, and integration with existing electrical infrastructure for sustainable and cost-effective energy.
HomePage.projectsSubtitle: A portfolio of major electrical projects across commercial, residential and governmental sectors.
